Zechariah 4:12: I asked a second time, “What are the two olive branches in the hands of the two golden nozzles that pour upon and draw up the golden pouring channels?”
Zechariah 4:13: He said to me, “Do you not know what these are?” I said, “No, lord.”
Zechariah 4:14: He said, “These two sons of richness stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
Zechariah 5:1: I turned and lifted my eyes and saw: look, a flying sickle!
Zechariah 5:2: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a flying sickle, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.”
Zechariah 5:3: He said to me, “This is the curse going out over the whole earth, because every thief will be punished by this with death, and every false swearer will be punished by this with death.
Zechariah 5:4: I will bring it out, says the Lord Almighty. It will enter the thief’s house and the house of whoever swears falsely by My name; it will lodge within his house and destroy it completely, its timbers and its stones.”
Zechariah 5:5: The angel speaking within me came out and said to me, “Look up with your eyes and see what this is that is coming out.”
Zechariah 5:6: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the measure coming out.” He said, “This is their injustice throughout the earth.”
Zechariah 5:7: Look, a talent of lead was being lifted out, and look, one woman was sitting inside the measure!
Zechariah 5:8: He said, “This is Lawlessness.” He threw her into the measure and threw the lead stone into her mouth.
Zechariah 5:9: I lifted my eyes and saw: look, two women coming out, with wind in their wings! They had wings like a hoopoe’s wings, and they lifted the measure between earth and heaven.
Zechariah 5:10: I said to the angel speaking within me, “Where are they carrying the measure?”
Zechariah 5:11: He said to me, “To build a house for it in Babylon’s land and prepare it; they will place it there on its prepared setting.”
Zechariah 6:1: I turned and lifted my eyes and saw: look, four chariots coming out from between two mountains! The mountains were bronze mountains.
Zechariah 6:2: The first chariot had flame-red horses, and the second chariot black horses,
Zechariah 6:3: the third chariot white horses, and the fourth chariot dappled, gray horses.
Zechariah 6:4: I answered and said to the angel speaking within me, “What are these, lord?”
Zechariah 6:5: The angel speaking within me answered, “These are the four winds of heaven; they go out to stand beside the Lord of all the earth.
Zechariah 6:6: The one with the black horses was going out toward the northern land; the white ones were going out behind them, and the dappled ones were going out toward the southern land,
Zechariah 6:7: and the gray ones were going out and looking to go and travel around the earth.” He said, “Go and travel around the earth!” And they traveled around the earth.
Zechariah 6:8: He cried out and said to me, “Look, those going out toward the northern land have brought My wrath to rest in the northern land.”
Zechariah 6:9: The word of the Lord came to me, saying:
Zechariah 6:10: “Take the things from the captivity, from its rulers, from its useful people and from those who have known it; you shall go that day into the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah, who has come from Babylon,
Zechariah 6:11: take silver and gold, make crowns and put them on the head of Joshua son of Josedek, the high priest,
Zechariah 6:12: and say to him: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Look, a man whose name is Rising! From beneath him he will rise, and he will build the Lord’s house.
Zechariah 6:13: He himself will receive excellence, sit and rule on his throne; the priest will be at his right hand, and peaceful counsel will be between both.
Zechariah 6:14: The crown will be for those who endure, for its useful people and those who have known it, for the favor of Zephaniah’s son and for a psalm in the Lord’s house.
Zechariah 6:15: Those far away from them will come and build in the Lord’s house, and you will know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you truly listen to the voice of the Lord your God.”
Zechariah 7:1: In the fourth year under King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, which is Chaseleu,
Zechariah 7:2: and Sarasar, King Arbeseer and his men sent to Bethel to appease the Lord,
Zechariah 7:3: saying to the priests in the house of the Lord Almighty and to the prophets, “The holy offering has come here in the fifth month, as I have already done for many years.”
Zechariah 7:4: The word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying:
Zechariah 7:5: “Say to all the land’s people and to the priests: If you fast or mourn at the fifth or seventh observances—and look, seventy years—surely you have not fasted a fast for Me?
Zechariah 7:6: If you eat or drink, are you not yourselves eating and yourselves drinking?
Zechariah 7:7: Are these not the words the Lord spoke through the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and flourishing, with her cities around her, and the hill country and plain were inhabited?”
Zechariah 7:8: The word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying:
Zechariah 7:9: “Thus says the Lord Almighty: Render righteous judgment; show mercy and compassion, each to his brother.
Zechariah 7:10: Do not oppress widow, orphan, newcomer or poor person, and let no one harbor resentment for his brother’s wrong in your hearts.”
Zechariah 7:11: But they refused to pay attention, turned a senseless back and made their ears heavy so as not to listen,
Zechariah 7:12: and made their heart disobedient, so as not to listen to My law and the words the Lord Almighty sent by His Spirit through the former prophets. Great anger came from the Lord Almighty.
Zechariah 7:13: It will be as He spoke and they did not listen to Him: so they will cry out, and I will certainly not listen, says the Lord Almighty.
Zechariah 7:14: I will cast them out among all the nations they did not know, and the land behind them will be obliterated, without anyone passing through or returning. They made a choice land a desolation.
Zechariah 8:1: The word of the Lord Almighty came, saying:
Zechariah 8:2: “Thus says the Lord Almighty: I have been jealous for Jerusalem and Zion with great jealousy; with great wrath I have been jealous for her.
Zechariah 8:3: Thus says the Lord: I will return to Zion and dwell within Jerusalem. Jerusalem will be called the True City, and the mountain of the Lord Almighty a Holy Mountain.
Zechariah 8:4: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Old men and old women will again sit in Jerusalem’s squares, each holding a staff in hand because of many days.
Zechariah 8:5: The city’s squares will be filled with boys and girls playing in her squares.
Zechariah 8:6: Thus says the Lord Almighty: If it is impossible before this people’s remnant in those days, surely it will not also be impossible before Me? says the Lord Almighty.
Zechariah 8:7: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Look, I am rescuing My people from the eastern land and from the western land,
Zechariah 8:8: and I will bring them in and dwell within Jerusalem. They will be My people, and I will be their God in truth and righteousness.
Zechariah 8:9: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Let your hands be strong, you who hear these words in these days from the prophets’ mouth, from the day when the house of the Lord Almighty was founded, and from when the temple was built.
Zechariah 8:10: Before those days people’s wages will bring no benefit, and animals’ hire will not exist; those going out or coming in will have no peace because of affliction. I will send everyone out against his neighbor.
Zechariah 8:11: Now I do not act toward this people’s remnant as in the former days, says the Lord Almighty,
Zechariah 8:12: but I will show peace: the vine will give its fruit, the earth its produce, and heaven its dew. I will give My people’s remnant all these as an inheritance.
